claims.claim: A Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society study of ECMWF 32-day ensemble forecasts found a forecast skill horizon of 16 to 23 days for instantaneous grid-point fields, averaged over one year, using the continuous ranked probability score against climatology.
claims.episode_span: that horizon for instantaneous grid-point fields sits between 16 and 23 days
claims.supporting_quote: On average over 1 year of forecasts, the forecast skill horizon for instantaneous, grid‐point fields is between 16 and 23 days, while it is considerably longer for time‐ and spatial‐average fields.

claims.claim: A Review of Economics and Statistics paper modeled GDP per capita for 113 countries from 1900 to 2017 and found that pooling tightens 100-year prediction intervals but uncertainty remains very wide.
claims.episode_span: GDP per capita for 113 countries over the 118 years from 1900 to 2017
claims.source_title: An Econometric Model of International Growth Dynamics for Long-Horizon Forecasting
claims.supporting_quote: Still, even using more than a century of data on many countries, the 100-year growth paths exhibit very wide uncertainty.

claims.claim: A 2011 Journal of Applied Econometrics paper found some forecastability of excess bond returns, with confidence intervals about twice as wide as the conventional approach.
claims.episode_span: Confidence intervals for the coefficients are about twice as wide as those from the conventional approach.
claims.supporting_quote: However, confidence intervals for the coefficients of the predictive regressions are about twice as wide as those obtained with the conventional approach to inference.

claims.claim: Water Resources Research derived a longest forecast horizon and an effective forecast horizon for reservoir operation, with the effective horizon defined using an error bound on release decisions.
claims.episode_span: The longest forecast horizon is how far a forecast must reach to set an optimal release
claims.source_title: Determining Inflow Forecast Horizon for Reservoir Operation
claims.supporting_quote: The LFH addresses the question of how long a forecast is sufficient to make an optimal reservoir release decision for the current stage if the effect of forecast uncertainty is not considered.

claims.claim: A 1993 Science paper forecast tropical Pacific sea-surface temperature first and then forced an atmospheric model, and reported good agreement for seven large climatic events of the 1970s to 1990s.
claims.episode_span: Forecasts of seven large climatic events of the 1970s to the 1990s agreed well with observations over many regions.
claims.source_title: A Two-Tiered Approach to Long-Range Climate Forecasting
claims.supporting_quote: Prediction of seven large climatic events of the 1970s to 1990s by this technique are in good agreement with observations over many regions of the globe.
